mapping.summary: Tracks company investment holdings in BC with live prices and gain/loss calculations.
claims: Tracks stocks, ETFs, fixed income, precious metals and commodities
Records quantity, purchase price, currency, date, category and ticker per asset
Refreshes live market prices per asset or for all assets on demand
Calculates total cost, current value and unrealised gain or loss per holding
Portfolio summary of invested amount, value and total return
Stock lookup by company name or ticker with quote details
Live gold, silver, platinum and palladium rates in several units and purities
Built-in currency converter using live rates
Signs in to Saifs AI with OAuth 2.0, credentials not stored in BC
No trading execution or investment advice
Requires internet and a Saifs AI account
